pages.lesson:
LESSON: EARLY CIVILISATION ● ASIA, ● EUROPE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.2: Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is cultural heritage important to society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast
2. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world
3. appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: EARLY CIVILISATION ● ASIA, ● EUROPE
This lesson teaches Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe for Grade 8 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe above.
2. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is cultural heritage important to society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe Swahili civilisation along the East African coast
2. show how best practices from early civilisations have contributed to the modern world
3. appreciate best practices of early civilisation to the development of the modern world

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
